cases.sentence: Мирьям и Аарон порицали _____ за жену-кушидку
cases.translation: Miriam and Aaron criticized Moses because of his Cushite wife
cases.explain: The verb 'порицали' (criticized) governs the Accusative case.

cases.sentence: Разве Господь говорил только с _____? Разве Он не говорил и с нами?
cases.translation: Has the Lord spoken only with Moses? Hasn't He spoken with us too?
cases.explain: The preposition 'с' (with) governs the Instrumental case.

cases.sentence: выйдите втроем к _____ собрания, и они вышли втроем
cases.translation: Go out to the tent of meeting
cases.explain: The preposition 'к' (to) governs the Dative case.

cases.sentence: Господь сошел в облачном столбе, он встал у входа в шатер, подозвал _____ и Мирьям
cases.translation: He stood at the tent entrance and called Aaron and Miriam
cases.explain: The verb 'подозвал' (called) governs the Accusative case.

cases.sentence: С ним я говорю лицом к ____, ясно, а не загадками
cases.translation: With him I speak mouth to mouth, plainly and not in riddles
cases.explain: The preposition 'к' (to) governs the Dative case in the phrase 'лицом к лицу' (face to face).

cases.sentence: Когда облако поднялось от шатра, _____ покрылась проказой, как снегом
cases.translation: When the cloud departed from the tent, Miriam became leprous, white as snow
cases.explain: The subject of the verb 'покрылась' (became covered) is in the Nominative case.

cases.sentence: Не дай ей стать похожей на мертворожденного младенца, у которого уже истлела половина тела, когда он вышел из материнского ___
cases.translation: Do not let her be like one dead, whose flesh is half consumed when coming from his mother's womb
cases.explain: The preposition 'из' (from) governs the Genitive case.

cases.sentence: Пусть ее выведут вне _____ на семь дней, потом она сможет вернуться
cases.translation: Let her be shut out from the camp for seven days, then she may be brought back
cases.explain: The preposition 'вне' (outside) governs the Genitive case.

reading.ru: Мирьям и Аарон порицали Моисея за жену-кушидку, потому что он женился на кушидке.
reading.question: What complaint did Miriam and Aaron have against Moses?
options: They criticized him because of his Cushite wife
reading.correct: They criticized him because of his Cushite wife
reading.explain: The text states: 'Мирьям и Аарон порицали Моисея за жену-кушидку' (Miriam and Aaron criticized Moses because of his Cushite wife).

reading.ru: Они говорили, «Разве Господь говорил только с Моисеем? Разве Он не говорил и с нами?»
reading.question: What was the real complaint of Miriam and Aaron?
options: Has the Lord spoken only with Moses? Hasn't He also spoken with us?
Moses did not listen to them
reading.correct: Has the Lord spoken only with Moses? Hasn't He also spoken with us?
reading.explain: Their complaint shows jealousy: 'Разве Господь говорил только с Моисеем? Разве Он не говорил и с нами?' (Has the Lord spoken only with Moses? Hasn't He spoken with us too?).

reading.ru: Но не так со слугой моим Моисеем. Он верен во всем моем доме. С ним я говорю лицом к лицу, ясно, а не загадками.
reading.question: How did the Lord distinguish Moses from other prophets?
options: Moses is unique in his faithfulness to My house; I speak with him face to face
reading.correct: Moses is unique in his faithfulness to My house; I speak with him face to face
reading.explain: The Lord said: 'Он верен во всем моем доме... С ним я говорю лицом к лицу' (He is faithful in all My house... With him I speak mouth to mouth).

reading.ru: Когда облако поднялось от шатра, Мирьям покрылась проказой, как снегом.
reading.question: What happened to Miriam as punishment?
options: She became leprous, white as snow
reading.correct: She became leprous, white as snow
reading.explain: The passage describes: 'Мирьям покрылась проказой, как снегом' (Miriam became leprous, white as snow).

reading.ru: И Моисеева звал Господу, «Боже, прошу, исцели ее».
reading.question: How did Moses respond to Miriam's affliction?
options: He called to God asking Him to heal her
He left her in the wilderness
reading.correct: He called to God asking Him to heal her
reading.explain: The text shows Moses' compassion: 'Моисеева звал Господу, «Боже, прошу, исцели ее»' (Moses cried out to the Lord, saying, 'God, I beg you, heal her').

reading.ru: Мирьям семь дней была заключена вне лагеря, и народ не трогался в путь, пока она не вернулась.
reading.question: What happened while Miriam was shut out from the camp?
options: The people made a new offering
The people did not travel until she returned
The people built a new tabernacle
reading.correct: The people did not travel until she returned
reading.explain: The text states: 'Мирьям семь дней была заключена вне лагеря, и народ не трогался в путь, пока она не вернулась' (Miriam was confined outside the camp for seven days, and the people did not travel until she was brought back).
